In my opinion, cities should make public transport free, because it helps people who don't have much money. I agree with Nora that fewer cars on the road are good for the environment. For example, in my hometown many students can't afford a monthly pass, so they walk for a long time or even miss classes, which affects their grades. Felix is right that buses are often late, and this is a serious problem. However, I believe that when transport is free, more people will use it, and the city will face public pressure to make it faster and more reliable. Therefore, free transport is the first step towards a city that works for everyone, not only for those who can pay.
